doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Working on Bessie Smith's show as chorus and pianist
summary: Billie did chorus work and then played piano when Bessie's pianist Clarence Williams fell ill.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Did you ever work on a show with her?
Bessie? Yeah, I did chorus work.
You did it in the chorus?
I did chorus work and I played piano.
I did it in the chorus. I did it in the chorus.

I did it in the chorus. See, Clarence William, Clarence William got sick, see, he couldn't work no more with her. And by me, I wasn't doing chorus, I could play piano right on, playing piano, that's why I got my style in the chorus, see. Like that.
